references.text: Joshua, son of Nun, was filled with the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. This verse describes the result of the laying on of hands that took place in Num 27:23.
The Lord's command to Moses to lay his hand on Joshua and share some of his authority with him, which Moses carries out in verse 23.
The expression 'by the hand of Moses' (בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה) is used to describe how the Lord speaks through His servant Moses.
Paul reminds Timothy to fan into flame the gift of God that is in him through the laying on of hands, a practice rooted in Old Testament ordination.
Timothy received his spiritual gift through the laying on of hands by the council of elders, reflecting the biblical tradition of transferring authority and blessing through the laying on of hands.
The apostles laid their hands on the seven chosen men after prayer, following the pattern established when Moses ordained Joshua.
The church in Antioch laid their hands on Barnabas and Saul and sent them off, continuing the biblical tradition of laying on of hands for commissioning into service.
